en.name: Standing cat–cow
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders, soften your knees and rest your hands lightly on your thighs above the knees.
As you breathe in, gently open your chest and tip your pelvis a little. Keep your neck comfortable; there is no need to look at the ceiling.
As you breathe out, gently round your back and let your chin lower a little without forcing it towards your chest.
Return to a comfortable middle position. Repeat slowly with your teacher.
en.focus: Teacher marks an open-and-round cycle. A side view supports observation; joint landmarks cannot measure spinal curvature or breathing.

zh-Hant.name: 站姿貓牛式變化
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙腳略寬於肩，膝蓋微彎，雙手輕放在膝蓋上方的大腿。
吸氣時輕輕打開胸口，骨盆微微轉動，頸部保持舒適，不用刻意望向天花板。
呼氣時輕輕拱背，下巴稍微降低，不要勉強貼近胸口。
回到舒適的中間位置，跟著老師慢慢重複。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次打開胸口及拱背記作一組；側面方便觀察，但關節點不能測量脊椎曲線或呼吸。
